QuestInfo.0: #bPason#k, the Florina Beach tour guide, needs your help. \n
QuestInfo.1: Pason says the number of #b#o1210104#s#k in #bBlue Ribbon Beach#k has grown rapidly, and subsequently, the number of tourists in Florina Beach has decreased. He asks you to eliminate #b50 #o1210104#s#k.\n\n#o1210104##r #a24791##k
